entry.name: new NBT method, attack attribute up swords
new NBT method, sharpness up to 25
entry.comment:
To edit NT Games NBT Editor codes
to edit what sword it is first go to line 3 to find what sword it is (E.G 10120001 00000450) and replace the 450 with another value, 450 = diamond sword 440 = stone sword. Find all references of 00000450 and replace it with another value
For example to change this entire code to stone swords change all lines with 00000450 to 00000440
Weapon Values 450 = diamond sword 440 = stone sword 42c = iron sword 430 = wooden sword 46c = golden sword 718 = trident 460 = a stick
Armor Values Leather 4a8 = leather helmet 4ac = leather chestplate 4b0 = leather leggings 4B4 = leather boots Chain 4b8 = chain helmet 4bc = chain chestplate 4c0 = chain leggings 4c4 = chain boots Iron 4c8 = iron helmet 4cc = iron chestplate 4d0 = iron leggings 4d4 = iron boots Gold 4e8 = gold helmet 4ec = gold chestplate 4f0 = gold leggings 4f4 = gold boots Diamond 4d8 = diamond helmet 4dc = diamond chestplate 4e0 = diamond leggings 4e4 = diamond boots
Region ID: AUMJ88

entry.name: new NBT method, attack attribute up swords
new NBT method, sharpness up to 25
entry.comment:
To edit NT Games NBT Editor codes
to edit what sword it is first go to line 3 to find what sword it is (E.G 10120001 00000450) and replace the 450 with another value, 450 = diamond sword 440 = stone sword. Find all references of 00000450 and replace it with another value
For example to change this entire code to stone swords change all lines with 00000450 to 00000440
Weapon Values 450 = diamond sword 440 = stone sword 42c = iron sword 430 = wooden sword 46c = golden sword 718 = trident 460 = a stick
Armor Values Leather 4a8 = leather helmet 4ac = leather chestplate 4b0 = leather leggings 4B4 = leather boots Chain 4b8 = chain helmet 4bc = chain chestplate 4c0 = chain leggings 4c4 = chain boots Iron 4c8 = iron helmet 4cc = iron chestplate 4d0 = iron leggings 4d4 = iron boots Gold 4e8 = gold helmet 4ec = gold chestplate 4f0 = gold leggings 4f4 = gold boots Diamond 4d8 = diamond helmet 4dc = diamond chestplate 4e0 = diamond leggings 4e4 = diamond boots

entry.name: □ [ Confirm player UUID (see address 10502000) ]
entry.comment:
Jump to address 10502000 in memory viewer 10502000~ is the host (1st player) 10502010~ is the second player 10502020~ is the third player ... 10502070~ is the 8th player The Xth is in the select menu. The order from the top. Even if the other party is invalid for expulsion by the UUID change method Partial matches can be used to identify 1234XXXXXX XXXX5678 12345678 12345678 The X's are often changed in the expulsion invalid often.
Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

entry.name: Fill Command
entry.comment:
### Fill Command
A Code that basically emulates the /fill command from Java / BE
Usage
``` down arrow key + L = keyboard display
/copy = copy your coordinates
/fill---^^^^ Block ID
/fill x-coordinate y-coordinate z-coordinate
No block ID in case of destruction ```
Once again, I know it's not Execute ASM, but like I said - don't really care.

entry.name: K-Aura API
entry.comment:
Please apply the body and API at the same time. (J Gecko U)
It is extracted in code format, not elf, so It is possible to penetrate the authentication.
How to use Attack the player you specify on ZR and cross once. (Multi-attack is also applicable)
ZR, cross right to attack the player within the reading range once simultaneously. (Multi Attack is also applied.)
LR - Cross down to specify (within reading range)
LR, cross left to adjust attack speed (L to decrease, R to increase)
LR, cross up to adjust multi-attack (Decrease with L, Increase with R)
Cross up x 5 to keep attacking the specified player automatically. Cross-left x 5 to continue to automatically attack all players within reading range at the same time
